title: Sectionwise boundaries for positive local Cech cocycles
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I a type, U:I→Opens(X) any family, F an O_X-module sheaf, D a nonnegative cochain complex of O_X-module sheaves, and e_p natural isomorphisms of global-ring-module presheaves from the underlying presheaves of D^p to the full categorical Cech complex of W↦(V↦F(W∩V)), commuting with the differentials. For every i∈I, p≥0, and open W of U_i, every section in degree p+1 of D restricted to U_i that is killed by the next differential is the differential of a section in degree p on that same open W. No covering or augmentation is assumed.

proof.text: Identify an open W of U_i with its image V⊆U_i in X. Evaluate e and hd on V. In Cech coordinates insert i at the first index to construct the primitive. The extra intersection with U_i equals V, deletion of the inserted first index contributes the original cocycle, and all other terms cancel by the cocycle equation with opposite alternating signs. Transport the primitive through e_p inverse and the restriction isomorphism on sections. The compatibility hd transports its boundary equation. This proves sectionwise lifting without any claim about sheaf homology or reflection of exactness.

theorem cech_sheaf_restrict_positive_section_boundary
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (F : X.Modules)
    (D : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (i : ι) (p : ℕ) :
    let K := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D
    ∀ (W : (U i).toScheme.Opens) (x : Γ((K.sc (p + 1)).X₂, W)),
      (K.sc (p + 1)).g.app W x = 0 →
        ∃ z : Γ((K.sc (p + 1)).X₁, W), (K.sc (p + 1)).f.app W z = x
